# IDOSI Journals

> IDOSI (International Digital Organization for Scientific Information) is an open-access scientific publishing platform hosting peer-reviewed journals across multiple disciplines with international editorial boards and comprehensive research databases.

IDOSI operates a network of peer-reviewed academic journals covering fields from medical sciences to animal diseases and mathematics, serving researchers globally with standardized submission processes and indexed research abstracts through its IAD and Eur-Asia databases.

## Key Topics

- Peer-reviewed journals
- Manuscript submission
- Editorial boards
- Publication ethics
- Academic publishing
- Journal databases
- Special issues
- Conference papers
- International Agricultural Database (IAD)
- Eur-Asia Database (EAD)
- World Journal of Medical Sciences
- Global Journal of Pharmacology
- Academic Journal of Animal Diseases
- Open-access publishing
- COPE guidelines

- [IDOSI Journals Databases](https://idosi.org/dbases.htm): IDOSI scientific databases including IAD and Eur-Asia for research abstracts
